mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Explore: the learner operates the gates, the paddles and the boat. Explain: the lock plays the steps of the list below, one at a time, in a bubble with Previous, Next and Replay. Display: the scene alone, moved only by screen events (the Command setting).

x-enum-labels.explore: Explore: the learner operates the lock

scenario.title: Journey
scenario.description: Uphill: the boat waits in the lower canal and must reach the upper one. Downhill: the boat floats in the full chamber and must reach the lower canal.

rise.title: Rise (m)
rise.description: Height between the lower and the upper canal, in metres. The chamber fills and empties in proportion.

hints.title: Hints
hints.description: Explore mode: show the Hint button (three hints, each more precise, for the step the learner is at).

allowViewChange.title: Learners change the view
allowViewChange.description: Show the 3D / Above / Section buttons, so learners can change the camera without losing what they did.

sound.title: Sound effects
sound.description: Soft sounds of water, gates and success, on at first. Learners can always mute them; they start after the learner's first click.

visualStyle.title: Visual style
visualStyle.description: Illustrated: watercolour colours with soft ink lines. Playful: bright, saturated colours and lively effects. Technical: a paper model with crisp ink lines and hatched cut faces.

cameraView.title: Camera
cameraView.description: Isometric: the diorama in three-quarter view. Top-down: seen from above. Section: cut along the canal, to read the water levels. Changing it keeps the simulation where it is.

informationLevel.title: Information level
informationLevel.description: Minimal: short names, no labels in the scene. Guided: plain names, the names of the canals and the chamber, and arrows where the water flows. Technical: trade names, the levels in metres, the level the water must reach, the level difference and the flows named.

showAnnotations.title: Annotations
showAnnotations.description: Labels and arrows drawn in the scene: names of the canals and the chamber and the flow of water (from Guided), the target level and the level difference (Technical).

motionIntensity.title: Motion
motionIntensity.description: Subtle: calm water and quiet effects. Expressive: livelier water, bobbing boat, spray and a celebration at the end. The rules and the timings of the lock stay the same; learners who ask their system for reduced motion always get the calm version.

entrance.title: Entrance
entrance.description: How the diorama appears: watercolour (pigments bloom on the paper, then the 3D scene shows through), a short fade, or at once.

phases.title: Steps of the explanation
phases.description: Explain mode: the steps learners go through, in order (one to six), each shown in a bubble pointing at what moves, with Previous and Next. Each plays a moment of the journey chosen in Journey; going on from a step that has ended continues from where the lock is.

x-enum-labels.level: The level changes, the boat follows

caption.title: Caption
caption.description: What the learner should notice, shown in the bubble under the title.

default.title: The barge sails in
default.caption: The chamber is at the level of the lower canal, so its lower gates stand open and the barge glides straight in.

default.title: The gates close behind it
default.caption: With the lower gates shut, the chamber becomes a closed basin: its water can no longer run away downstream.

default.title: Water flows in from above
default.caption: Opening the paddles, small sluices in the upper gates, lets water run downhill from the upper canal into the chamber.

default.title: The boat floats up
default.caption: As the chamber fills, its surface rises, and the barge floats up with it. Nothing pushes it but the water beneath.

default.title: Level water, open gates
default.caption: The chamber is now level with the upper canal. The water pushes as hard on both sides of the gates, so they swing open easily.

default.title: On its way, higher up
default.caption: The barge sails out into the upper canal. The lock never lifted it: the water did.

demoStep.title: Step to play
demoStep.description: Explain mode: the step that plays when the object appears (0: wait for the learner). A screen event can set it to play another step.

command.title: Command
command.description: For screen events (set object props) and dialogue choices: each time it is set, the lock runs that operation under the same rules as for learners (gates refuse to open while levels differ). Leave None in the block.

grassColor.title: Grass
grassColor.description: Colour of the grass on the banks.

earthColor.title: Earth
earthColor.description: Colour of the earth seen where the slice is cut; clay and towpath are derived from it.

stoneColor.title: Stone
stoneColor.description: Colour of the lock's masonry; the coping stones are a lighter shade.

gateColor.title: Gates
gateColor.description: Colour of the gate leaves and their balance beams (the beam ends stay white).

hullColor.title: Hull
hullColor.description: Colour of the barge's hull (playful style: the accent colour instead).

ctlLowerGates.description: Button and label of the lower pair of gates; level is the information level

ctlUpperGates.text: {level, select, minimal {Gates} technical {Upstream gates} other {Upper gates}}
ctlUpperGates.description: Button and label of the upper pair of gates

ctlLowerPaddles.text: {level, select, minimal {Paddles} technical {Downstream paddles} other {Lower paddles}}
ctlLowerPaddles.description: Button of the paddles (sluices) in the lower gates

ctlUpperPaddles.text: {level, select, minimal {Paddles} technical {Upstream paddles} other {Upper paddles}}
ctlUpperPaddles.description: Button of the paddles (sluices) in the upper gates

stOpen.description: State of gates or paddles, under their name

stClosed.description: State of gates or paddles, under their name

stOpening.description: State while gates or paddles move

stClosing.description: State while gates or paddles move

ariaToggleOpen.description: Screen reader name of a closed control

ariaToggleClose.description: Screen reader name of an open control

boatAhead.description: Button with an arrow that moves the boat towards its goal (its name for screen readers and its tooltip)

boatBack.description: Button with an arrow that moves the boat back the way it came (its name and tooltip)

toolHint.description: Button that shows the next hint

hintClose.description: Screen reader name of the button that closes the hint

toolReset.description: Button that puts the lock back as at the start

toolSound.description: Toggle button for the sound effects

pauseAria.description: Button that freezes the water and the boat's bobbing

viewLabel.description: Name of the group of camera buttons

zoneChamber.description: Label on the chamber between the gates

zoneLevel.description: Label with the water level (technical); value is formatted, with its sign

diffLabel.text: {level, select, technical {Δh {d} m} other {{d} m to go}}
diffLabel.description: Level difference between the chamber and the water it must reach; d is formatted

sameLevel.description: The chamber is level with the canal next to it

flowIn.text: {level, select, technical {Inflow through the paddles} other {Water flows in}}
flowIn.description: Arrow of water entering the chamber

flowOut.text: {level, select, technical {Outflow through the paddles} other {Water flows out}}
flowOut.description: Arrow of water leaving the chamber

stepPrev.description: Explain mode: button of the bubble (its name for screen readers and its tooltip)

stepNext.description: Explain mode: button of the bubble (its name for screen readers and its tooltip)

replay.description: Explain mode: button of the bubble that plays the current step again (its name and tooltip)

readyUphill.text: Your barge is waiting below the lock. Bring it up to the upper canal.

readyDownhill.text: Your barge floats in the full chamber. Bring it down to the lower canal.

gateOpening.text: {gate, select, lower {The lower gates swing open.} other {The upper gates swing open.}}
gateOpening.description: Status when gates start to open

gateClosing.text: {gate, select, lower {The lower gates swing shut.} other {The upper gates swing shut.}}
gateClosing.description: Status when gates start to close

fill.text: {level, select, minimal {The chamber is filling.} other {Water pours in from the upper canal: the chamber is filling.}}
fill.description: Status: upper paddles opened, gates shut

drain.text: {level, select, minimal {The chamber is emptying.} other {Water runs out to the lower canal: the chamber is emptying.}}
drain.description: Status: lower paddles opened, gates shut

leak.text: Water rushes in from above… and straight out through the open lower gates. The chamber can't fill like this.
leak.description: Status: upper paddles opened while the lower gates stand open

leakDown.text: Water from the upper canal runs through the open upper gates and out below. The chamber can't empty like this.
leakDown.description: Status: lower paddles opened while the upper gates stand open

through.text: Now water runs in at the top and out at the bottom: the level will stop halfway.
through.description: Status: both paddles open, gates shut

noFlow.text: Nothing flows: the water is already at the same level on both sides.
noFlow.description: Status: paddles opened between equal levels

paddlesClosed.text: {side, select, lower {Lower paddles closed.} other {Upper paddles closed.}}

levelUpper.text: The chamber is level with the upper canal. The upper gates can open now.
levelUpper.description: Status: levels have just become equal on the upper side

levelLower.text: The chamber is level with the lower canal. The lower gates can open now.
levelLower.description: Status: levels have just become equal on the lower side

settled.text: The level has stopped halfway: water flows in as fast as it flows out.
settled.description: Status: both paddles open, level settled

boatSails.text: {to, select, chamber {The boat glides into the chamber.} upper {The boat sails out into the upper canal.} other {The boat sails out into the lower canal.}}

boatInChamber.text: The boat is in the chamber.
boatInChamber.description: Status: the boat has arrived in the chamber

boatBackOut.text: The boat is back in the canal it came from.

waitingGate.text: The boat will set off as soon as the gates are fully open.
waitingGate.description: Status: move asked while the gates open

waitingLevel.text: The gates will open as soon as the levels match.
waitingLevel.description: Status: a screen event asked for gates while the level changes

successUphill.text: Your barge is in the upper canal! It climbed {rise} m, carried all the way by the water.
successUphill.description: Status at the end, uphill; rise is formatted

successDownhill.text: Your barge is in the lower canal. It came down {rise} m, riding the water as it drained.

refuseLevels.text: {level, select, minimal {The gates won't move: the water levels differ.} technical {The gates won't move: a head of {d} m presses them shut. Equalise the levels first.} other {The gates won't budge: the water is {d} m higher on one side and pushes them shut. Make the levels equal first.}}
refuseLevels.description: Reaction: gates asked to open while levels differ; d is formatted

refuseGateClosed.text: {gate, select, lower {The lower gates are closed: the boat can't pass.} other {The upper gates are closed: the boat can't pass.}}
refuseGateClosed.description: Reaction: boat asked to move through closed gates

refuseEnd.text: The boat can't go any further this way.
refuseEnd.description: Reaction: boat asked to go past the end

refuseBoatPassing.text: Wait until the boat has cleared the gates.
refuseBoatPassing.description: Reaction: gates asked to close while the boat passes

refuseMoving.text: The boat is already on its way.
refuseMoving.description: Reaction: boat asked to move while moving

resetDone.text: The lock is back as it was at the start.

nudgeGates.text: A pair of gates only opens when the water is at the same level on both sides.

nudgeEnter.text: The way is clear. What does the boat need to do now?

nudgeSeal.text: To change the level in the chamber, it must be closed off at both ends.

nudgeWater.text: Water only flows downhill. Where can the chamber get water from, or send it to?

nudgeWait.text: Moving water takes a little time. Watch the level.

doOpenLowerGates.text: The chamber is level with the lower canal: open the lower gates.

doOpenUpperGates.text: The chamber is level with the upper canal: open the upper gates.

doEnter.text: Sail the boat into the chamber.

doExit.text: Sail the boat out of the chamber.

doCloseLowerGates.text: Close the lower gates, so the chamber is closed off.

doCloseUpperGates.text: Close the upper gates, so the chamber is closed off.

doCloseLowerPaddles.text: Close the lower paddles, or water will keep running out.

doCloseUpperPaddles.text: Close the upper paddles, or water will keep running in.

doFill.text: Open the upper paddles to let water in from the upper canal.

doDrain.text: Open the lower paddles to let water out to the lower canal.

doWaitFill.text: Wait while the chamber fills: the boat rises with it.

doWaitDrain.text: Wait while the chamber empties: the boat goes down with it.

doWaitBoat.text: Let the boat finish its move.

doTurnBack.text: The boat went the wrong way: back up towards the lock.

showControl.description: Hint 3: names the control to use

showWait.text: Nothing to press for now: just watch the water.

hintDone.text: Your boat has arrived: nothing left to do!
hintDone.description: Hint when the goal is reached

level.description: Chamber level in metres above the lower canal

step.description: Explain mode: the step shown (1 to 6, 0 before any)

seen.description: Explain mode: steps played to their end, one bit each

lab.description: Explore mode: the lock as the learner left it, found again when they come back to an explore block of the chain (continuity, D65). Compact: journey (u or d), chamber level, lower gates, upper gates, lower paddles, upper paddles (o or c), boat (l, c or u), done (1 or 0), comma-separated.

events.name: manoeuvre
events.description: The lock was operated (by the learner or a screen event): action names the operation; accepted is false when the lock refused it, and reason says why.

events.name: level_equal
events.description: The chamber has just become level with one of the canals (side: lower or upper).

events.name: boat_arrived
events.description: The boat finished a move (where: lower, chamber or upper).

events.name: hint_shown
events.description: Explore mode: the learner asked for a hint (level 1 to 3).

events.name: step_viewed
events.description: Explain mode: a step played to its end (index from 1).

events.name: completed
events.description: Explore mode: the boat reached its goal. Explain mode: the last step played to its end.

a11y.description: A small 3D diorama of a canal lock, cut clean at both ends: the lower canal, a stone chamber between two pairs of black mitre gates with white-tipped balance beams, and the upper canal higher up. A barge floats on the water; paddles in the gates let water through, and the level of the chamber rises or falls while the boat floats with it.
a11y.keyboard: Tab reaches each control in reading order: the lower gates, lower paddles, upper paddles, upper gates, the boat's two moves, then Hint, Reset, the views, Sound and Pause; in the explanation, the bubble's Replay, Previous and Next. Enter or Space operates it; each result is announced.
a11y.dragAlternative: Nothing needs dragging: every action is a button.
